Work

Things that shipped, then had to keep working. Notes are linked where I wrote them up.

Production

  • Claude connector

    Apollo's connector and MCP server for Claude. From a chat you can search people, enrich them, and add them to a sequence. A small team shipped it in about ten days. I was on that team.

  • Message accounting end to end

    Outbound across email, SMS, app, and WhatsApp. What we sent and what we could prove at the other end did not match, and the logs argued with us. We split the metrics by stage, dropped the fake failures, and got to 100% accounting from source to target.

    The counts did not add up

  • Cost, quality, and a retry storm

    Cut AWS cost about 21% by clearing network and disk bottlenecks. SonarQube quality scores up 78% across services. Rebuilt WhatsApp as a bot-of-bots. Separate mess: one slow Aerospike shard, then retries lined up and took the system with it. Fix was skip the bad keys, then backoff with jitter.

    One slow shard
